title: Advertise
subtitle: 宣傳、推廣、行銷、公開宣傳——哪些詞真的接近 advertise？
description: 宣傳、推廣、行銷、公開宣傳——哪些詞真的接近 advertise？

words.note: 最常見、最廣泛的近義詞之一。表示提高某產品、服務、活動、作品或品牌的知名度並吸引更多人注意或使用。

exercises.original: The company advertised its new app through social media and online videos.
exercises.upgrade: The company advertised its new app through social media and online videos.

options.explanation: 也可，但更偏整體商業策略。

exercises.original: The museum is advertising a new exhibition to attract younger visitors.
exercises.upgrade: The museum is advertising a new exhibition to attract younger visitors.

exercises.original: The tourism board advertised the region as a year-round destination.
exercises.upgrade: The tourism board advertised the region as a year-round destination.

options.explanation: 推廣地方／目的地非常自然。
通常面向特定買家或客戶。

words.note: 表示以商業策略推廣產品或服務，通常不只是單一廣告，而包括定位、目標客群、宣傳方式和銷售策略。

exercises.original: The company advertises its premium coffee mainly to young professionals.
exercises.upgrade: The company advertises its premium coffee mainly to young professionals.

options.explanation: 也可，但不如 market 突出市場定位。
通常是一對一／特定客戶。

exercises.original: The software is advertised internationally as a tool for small businesses.
exercises.upgrade: The software is advertised internationally as a tool for small businesses.

options.explanation: 可以宣傳，但較少市場策略意味。

exercises.original: The brand plans to advertise the new product to environmentally conscious consumers.
exercises.upgrade: The brand plans to advertise the new product to environmentally conscious consumers.

options.explanation: 若是直接向客戶推介才更合適。

words.note: 表示讓更多人知道某個活動、事件、產品、計劃或資訊。英式常拼 publicise，美式常拼 publicize。

exercises.original: The organisers advertised the charity concert through local newspapers.
exercises.upgrade: The organisers advertised the charity concert through local newspapers.

options.explanation: 是售票／銷售，不是宣傳本身。
只公布，不一定持續宣傳。

exercises.original: The council advertised the new recycling programme across the city.
exercises.upgrade: The council advertised the new recycling programme across the city.

options.explanation: 公共資訊／計劃宣傳很自然。

exercises.original: The university advertised the scholarship widely before the application deadline.
exercises.upgrade: The university advertised the scholarship widely before the application deadline.

options.explanation: 讓更多潛在申請者知道。
也可，但 publicise 更直接。

words.note: 非正式用語，表示積極宣傳或推薦某個產品、節目、書籍、活動或作品。

exercises.original: The actor used the interview to advertise his new film.
exercises.upgrade: The actor used the interview to advertise his new film.

options.explanation: 非正式地趁機宣傳作品。
不像演員本人在訪談中的行為。

exercises.original: She spent the final minute of the podcast advertising her new book.
exercises.upgrade: She spent the final minute of the podcast advertising her new book.

exercises.original: The presenter kept advertising the station's upcoming comedy show.
exercises.upgrade: The presenter kept advertising the station's upcoming comedy show.

options.explanation: 主持人非正式宣傳節目。

words.note: 表示積極地宣稱某產品、服務、人物或計劃很好、很重要或值得注意。通常比 advertise 更帶有強力推銷或吹捧意味。

exercises.original: The developer advertised the building as the most advanced office complex in the city.
exercises.upgrade: The developer advertised the building as the most advanced office complex in the city.

options.explanation: tout something as... 是典型搭配。
也可能，但不突出強烈宣稱。

exercises.original: The new phone is being advertised as a major breakthrough in mobile photography.
exercises.upgrade: The new phone is being advertised as a major breakthrough in mobile photography.

options.explanation: 強調被宣揚為「重大突破」。

exercises.original: The resort advertises itself as an exclusive destination for luxury travellers.
exercises.upgrade: The resort advertises itself as an exclusive destination for luxury travellers.

options.explanation: 強調自我宣稱其優越性。
若直接向客戶介紹才更合。

words.note: 表示以說服方式介紹產品、服務、想法或方案，通常有明確對象，例如客戶、投資者或買家。

exercises.original: The salesperson advertised the software directly to the hospital's management team.
exercises.upgrade: The salesperson advertised the software directly to the hospital's management team.

exercises.original: The agency advertised the campaign idea to the client during a presentation.
exercises.upgrade: The agency advertised the campaign idea to the client during a presentation.

options.explanation: 可接產品，不如 pitch 精確。

exercises.original: The startup founder advertised the service to potential investors and business partners.
exercises.upgrade: The startup founder advertised the service to potential investors and business partners.

options.explanation: 明確面向投資者／合作夥伴。

words.note: 表示積極促銷或推動某產品、服務、品牌或方案，常帶有較強的銷售壓力或商業推廣意味。

exercises.original: The retailer is advertising its new membership programme very aggressively this month.
exercises.upgrade: The retailer is advertising its new membership programme very aggressively this month.

options.explanation: 短期強力促銷語感最合適。
太口語且通常由人或媒體推介。

exercises.original: The company is advertising the premium version more heavily than the basic plan.
exercises.upgrade: The company is advertising the premium version more heavily than the basic plan.

options.explanation: 表示公司正重點力推某版本。

exercises.original: Sales staff were told to advertise the extended warranty whenever possible.
exercises.upgrade: Sales staff were told to advertise the extended warranty whenever possible.

options.explanation: 口語但不如 push 符合銷售壓力。
可能是真誠建議，不等同積極促銷。

falseSynonyms.zh: 宣布不等於宣傳 Announce 只是正式告知消息；advertise 通常希望吸引注意、顧客或申請者。
falseSynonyms.point: The company announced the launch date. The company advertised the new product online.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提供資訊不等於推廣 Inform 重點是讓人知道資訊，不要求有宣傳或說服目的。
出售不等於宣傳 Sell 是實際完成銷售；advertise 是在銷售之前吸引顧客。
建立品牌不等於單次宣傳 Brand 涉及塑造品牌身份、形象和定位，而不只是把產品宣傳出去。
贊助不等於廣告 Sponsor 是提供資金或支持，雖然贊助常帶來曝光，但不是 advertise 的同義詞。
推薦不等於廣告 個人可以真誠推薦某產品，但未必是在做商業宣傳。
展示不等於宣傳 把產品展示出來可能是廣告的一部分，但 display 本身只表示陳列或顯示。
播出不等於宣傳 Broadcast 是透過電視、電台或網絡傳送內容；內容可以是廣告，也可以不是。
